description: This file defines the GatewayConnectChallengeSupport enum with static functions to handle nonces and timeout logic related to gateway connection challenges, integrating with the OpenClawProtocol.

methods.name: nonce(from:)
methods.description: Extracts and trims a nonce string from a payload dictionary.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:)
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce to be received within a specified timeout, utilizing an async timeout mechanism.
